title: Simple Plate Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later), P300‑Multi Channel Pipette, NEST 96 Deepwell Plate 2 mL (source plate), Greiner Microlon 96‑Well Plate 340 µL (up to nine destination plates), and appropriate tip racks.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters (source plate, number of destination plates, volumes, etc.) in the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Download the custom protocol file that the app creates based on the entered parameters.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up your deck according to the provided deck map, placing the source plate, up to nine destination plates, tip rack, and the P300‑Multi Channel Pipette in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the labware, tip rack, and P300‑Multi Channel Pipette as described in the calibration support articles.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the plate‑transfer protocol.
